settings.title: Top Pages
settings.lead: Top Pages components read a page-hit report produced by AWStats. A report configuration says where that report lives and which of its rows are kept; every configuration stored here is offered to editors when they place a Top Pages component.

error.unknown: The server refused the operation without saying why; see the server log.

configurations.title: Report configurations
configurations.description: Stored under /settings/top-pages, one node per configuration, shared by every site.
configurations.confirmDelete: Delete the configuration "{{name}}"? Components bound to it will stop resolving a report.
configurations.emptyHint: Add one to point the Top Pages components at an AWStats report.

name.label: Name
name.hint: Also the JCR node name, so letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore only.

awStatsUrl.label: AWStats report URL
awStatsUrl.hint: Location of the awstats script, for example http://stats.example.com/awstats.pl

includeFilter.label: Include filter
includeFilter.hint: Passed to AWStats as urlfilter; leave empty to keep every row.

excludeFilter.label: Exclude filter
excludeFilter.hint: Comma-separated URL fragments dropped from the report.

titleFromHTML.label: Read titles from the page HTML
titleFromHTML.hint: Fetches each page and uses its title element, instead of the label AWStats reports.

titleSeparator.label: Title separator
titleSeparator.hint: Everything after this separator is stripped from a title read from HTML.

nodes.title: Top Pages components
nodes.description: Every jtopmix:topPages node in the repository, with the configuration it reads and the page it is rendered in. This is the screen to open when a component shows nothing.
nodes.empty: No Top Pages node exists in this repository.
